name: cleverence-mslx
description: Read, understand and safely edit Cleverence Mobile SMARTS (Склад 15 / Магазин 15) configuration stored as .mslx files - the XML algorithm graphs that drive handheld terminal (ТСД) workflows in 1C integration projects. Use this skill whenever the task touches Cleverence / Mobile SMARTS / "Клеверенс" / ТСД algorithms, .mslx files, document types or operations (обработчики) on the terminal, menu/scan/КМ logic on a scanner, calling 1C online from the TSD, or "почему скан не срабатывает / действие не найдено / кнопка не работает" on a handheld - even if the user does not say ".mslx" explicitly. Covers the action graph, transition chaining, OperationAction parameter mapping, the online 1C call mechanism, marking-code (КМ) line operations, and the CL_-copy rule for not breaking vendor operations on update.
